name: Intro Unclear Response Escalation
goal: User provides unclear responses three times at the intro step, triggering escalation.
constraints: User never selects a valid quick reply; escalation must occur after 3 invalid attempts.

phases.description: User provides three unclear responses at the intro step.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot re-prompts after each invalid input; after third, bot escalates with the exact escalation message.

manualPrereqs: Chrome must be open and logged into Google Chat as the test user
